events.title: Dev Update: Thank you for 2,000 wishlists!
events.summary: Hey everyone!We've just passed 2,000 wishlists on Steam, and we wanted to take a moment to say thank you!As a small indie team, seeing so many people interested in Tetra Rise means a lot to us. Every wishlist is someone choosing to keep an eye on our game, and we're incredibly grateful for your support.Since launching the demo, we've been working hard to improve the game and add new content. events.title: Tetra Rise is in Steam Next Fest! Seven new additions to discover
events.summary: Hey everyone!Steam Next Fest is underway, and Tetra Rise is taking part! If you've been meaning to try the demo, this is a great time to jump into the abyss.Tetra Rise is an action-platformer roguelite where defeated enemies drop blocks you can use as platforms on your way up. events.title: Demo Available Now!
events.summary: Hey everyone,Today is a big day for us. After months of development, we're excited to finally share the first public demo of Tetra Rise!Before you jump in, here are a few things worth knowing:The demo contains the entire first area of the game, including the first boss.Since Tetra Rise is a roguelite, you can replay the demo as many times as you'd like.
